sourceProof.interval: The derivative of g(t)=exp(-2.2t)cos(5.2t) vanishes at (k*pi-atan(2.2/5.2))/5.2; alternating absolute extrema decay monotonically. Endpoint, limit0 and first two future critical points give exact infinite-tail ranges for t>=0/full or t>=.45/strict held. Full exit convexly blends g with 1.5, then signed swing multiplication and persistent sine +/-1.2 preserve asymmetric angle bounds for every ltb/ghost clock. Native outBack exact cubic overshoot bounds drop in [-.4H,+.4H*4*1.4^3/(27*2.4^2)]. Invert actual recorded body rotation/drop, then independent trig products with all four Cartesian corners. Line endpoints are swept before independently adding their complete device-axis miter/AA pad; a world AABB is never assumed rotation-covariant. Full-size current price plus its source origin encloses growth; strike endpoints enclose its entire native reveal. Fixed primary pin is separate and strict whenever drawn.
